assessment: This article documents a novel aspect of how T cell activation is regulated by the PTPN22 phosphatase, namely, reversible oxidation, which transiently reduces the activity of PTPN22 to allow the T cell antigen receptor to drive a strong activation signal. This compelling work adds to our understanding of how an immune response is initiated and provides new insights that could be exploited for the development of new drugs to treat immune-mediated diseases.
